name: Nat's Landing
summary: At Nat's Landing, fishermen come to Dustwallow Bay seeking Nat Pagle's highest instruction. The famous angler keeps a quiet camp there.

sections.title: A Master's Haven
sections.body: Southwest of Theramore Isle, you find Nat's Landing beside the murky waters of Dustwallow Bay. A canvas tent, drying racks for the day's catch, spare tackle in the trees, and a rickety pier mark the weathered camp. Mists and swamp dangers surround this quiet shore. Nat Pagle comes here for solitude and a drink, away from the clamor of civilization.

sections.title: The Fisherman's Pilgrimage
sections.body: Anglers who have learned all they can from trainers in Ironforge, Orgrimmar, and elsewhere are sent to Nat Pagle. Politics and factional quarrels mean nothing to him. To earn his highest instruction, you must brave marshland predators and show patience and skill across the world's most perilous waters.

aliases: how to get to nats landing
faq.answer: Nat's Landing lies along Dustwallow Bay in eastern Dustwallow Marsh, southwest of Theramore Isle.
Nat Pagle, the renowned human angler, keeps his personal campsite at Nat's Landing.
Fishermen who have learned all they can from local trainers travel to Nat Pagle. He tests their dedication with challenging catches around the world before teaching them at the highest level.

faq.q: Does Nat Pagle welcome both Alliance and Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. Nat Pagle welcomes dedicated anglers from either faction, regardless of their loyalties.

angles.text: As an Alliance citizen stationed in Theramore, you can walk a short, quiet way down the coast to Nat's Landing and reach the world's premier fisherman.
As a Horde angler crossing the perilous swamp from the Barrens, you will find Nat indifferent to the war. He judges visitors by the quality of their cast.
